lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows across the lateral flank. The clusters exhibit a higher spatial density and smaller diameter in the anterior region near the pectoral fin, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced nodes as they progress posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity run perpendicular to the body axis, acting as a substrate for the high-luminance blobs which are positioned centrally within these bands, forming a grid-like arrangement of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal feature in the upper third of the frame characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition, with a lighter upper edge and a shadowed lower edge, indicating a structural ridge running parallel to the dorsal midline.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two Echeneidae (remora) individuals: one visible as a dark, elongated silhouette near the ventral midline posterior to the pectoral fin, and another partially visible along the lower posterior flank.
